integration_flow.step_2: Client generates API Key from dashboard — My Account → API Keys → Generate New Key
integration_flow.step_3_option_A: Submit M1 Fund JSON via POST /api/v1/payloads/m1-fund with X-API-Key header
integration_flow.step_3_option_B: Initiate Master-to-Master SWIFT wire to IBAN AE960260001015754367301 at Emirates NBD BIC EBILAEADXXX
integration_flow.step_4: System returns ALSH-M1 reference number and SHA-256 payload hash as receipt
integration_flow.step_5: ALSHUMOOKH compliance team reviews within 1 business day
integration_flow.step_6: Upon approval — tokenization initiated: EUR → USD → USDT ERC-20
integration_flow.step_7: USDT transferred on-chain to agreed beneficiary wallet — gas fees paid by ALSHUMOOKH
integration_flow.step_8: Full audit trail and settlement confirmation provided
